question: Why would no one rationally seek to bring calamity upon such a being?
premises: Bringing calamity is considered as a deliberate act
Such an act would result in self-injury
No one seeks self-injury without cause
inference: No one would seek to harm such a being, as doing so would amount to self-injury.
plain_english: Who would seek to bring calamity, except as an act of self-injury?
